IdempotentReplayed.description: Present with value `true` when Edge replayed a stored successful response for the supplied Idempotency-Key. Omitted for first-time requests and error responses.

IdempotencyKey.description: Optional opaque, unquoted key for safely retrying the same logical request. Keys must contain 1 to 255 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores. Generate a unique UUID v4 for each operation and reuse it only when retrying that operation with the same request. Invalid headers—including duplicate, empty, malformed, or overlong values—return 400 with error code 10015. A request already in progress with the same key returns 409; reusing the key with a different request returns 422. Only successful responses are replayed, for up to 24 hours. Do not include sensitive data in the key.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

errors.detail: The request body exceeds the Edge replay-protection limit for idempotent requests.
errors.title: Payload Too Large

IdempotencyPayloadTooLargeResponse.description: Payload Too Large. A request sent with an Idempotency-Key whose body exceeds the endpoint's Edge replay-protection limit (256 KB) is rejected before it reaches the service (code 10007). Requests sent without the header are not subject to this limit.

errors.detail: Edge idempotency protection is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.title: Service Unavailable

IdempotencyProtectionUnavailableResponse.description: Service unavailable (10016), including unavailable Edge idempotency protection for a keyed request. Retry with the same key.

errors.detail: A request with this Idempotency-Key is already being processed.
errors.title: Resource is being processed

messaging_IdempotencyConflictResponse.description: A request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed (10036). Retry later with the same key and request.
